questions.stem: What was Lamarck's theory of evolution?

options.text: That characteristics acquired during an organism's lifetime can be passed to offspring
That evolution occurs through genetic engineering
That all organisms share a common ancestor through DNA
That species evolve through natural selection

questions.explanation: Lamarck proposed that organisms could pass on characteristics they developed during their lifetime (e.g., a blacksmith's children would have strong arms). This theory has since been disproved.
